title: Article nuance
note: the three generics (bare plural, a + singular as a rule about any member, the + singular as the species) and where the definite singular stops being generic · article-free prepositional phrases (by car / on foot, in person, by hand, on average, in detail, in charge of, on behalf of) and repeated-bare-noun pairs (side by side, face to face, step by step) · abstract nouns going countable (business/a business, experience/an experience, success/a success, time/a great time, difficulty/a difficulty, doubt) · the forced by structure: a noun pinned by a that-clause or a relative, plus the quantity frames incl. the number of vs a number of · deliberately avoids ground owned elsewhere: institutions, proper and geographic names, meals, media, instruments, jobs with a/an and first-vs-later mention are b1_articles_advanced; the bare-plural and uncountable generics, the + adjective for a group, the + nationality, the + unique noun and generic-vs-specific minimal pairs are all b2_articles_genericity, so this unit teaches only the two SINGULAR generics B2 never covers · 4 strands x 12 · 48 items · built to live 2026-08-07 (cloud run 18)

cards.title: The two singular generics
cards.body: You already have the bare plural for a whole class — Books are cheaper than films. English has two more, both singular, and neither is a free variant of it. The indefinite singular picks any one member as a representative, and it is the frame for rules and definitions: A good doctor listens before speaking means any doctor, not one the reader has in mind. The definite singular treats the class as a single species or institution and belongs in formal and scientific writing: The horse was once the fastest way to travel. Czech marks none of this, so the choice has to be read off the sentence type rather than off the Czech — a rule about any member takes a, a formal statement about the class as a whole takes the. The definite singular is the dangerous one: attach anything identifying to the noun and it stops naming the class at all. The bicycle in the garden is mine is one bicycle, not bicycles in general.
cards.body_cz: Holé množné číslo pro celou třídu už znáte — Books are cheaper than films. Angličtina má ještě dva další způsoby, oba v jednotném čísle, a ani jeden není jeho volnou variantou. Neurčitý jednotný tvar vybírá kteréhokoli zástupce a je to vazba pro pravidla a definice: A good doctor listens before speaking znamená kterýkoli lékař, ne jeden konkrétní. Určitý jednotný tvar bere třídu jako druh nebo instituci a patří do odborného a formálního stylu: The horse was once the fastest way to travel. Čeština nic z toho neznačí, takže se volba musí odvodit z typu věty, ne z češtiny — pravidlo o kterémkoli zástupci má a, formální tvrzení o celku má the. Nebezpečný je ten určitý jednotný tvar: jakmile k podstatnému jménu připojíte cokoli identifikujícího, přestane označovat třídu. The bicycle in the garden is mine je jedno konkrétní kolo, ne kola obecně.

table.caption: naming a whole class
rows: A good doctor listens before speaking.
The horse was once the fastest way to travel.
The bicycle in the garden is mine.

points: a + singular states a rule about any member of the class.
the + singular names the species, and belongs in formal and scientific writing.
Anything identifying attached to the noun kills the generic reading.

cards.title: Phrases where the noun stays bare
cards.title_cz: Vazby, kde podstatné jméno zůstává bez členu
cards.body: A large group of prepositional phrases carries no article at all, and adding one does not change the meaning — it breaks the phrase. Transport takes by with a bare noun after it: by car, by train, by bus, and on foot is the odd member of the same family. Manner and measure behave the same way: in person, by hand, on average, in detail. So do the phrases that hand someone a role: in charge of, on behalf of. English also builds fixed pairs by repeating a bare noun on both sides of a preposition — side by side, face to face, step by step, day by day. Czech uses a preposition and a case here and gives no warning that the English noun has to stay bare, which is why these are learned whole rather than assembled: there is no rule to apply, only a phrase to recognise.
cards.body_cz: Velká skupina předložkových vazeb nemá člen vůbec a jeho přidáním se význam nezmění — rozbije se celá vazba. Dopravní prostředek se pojí s by a holým podstatným jménem: by car, by train, by bus, a on foot je zvláštní člen téže rodiny. Stejně se chovají vazby způsobu a míry: in person, by hand, on average, in detail. A také vazby, které někomu přisuzují roli: in charge of, on behalf of. Angličtina si navíc tvoří ustálené dvojice tím, že holé podstatné jméno zopakuje na obou stranách předložky — side by side, face to face, step by step, day by day. Čeština tu volí předložku a pád a nijak nenaznačí, že anglické podstatné jméno musí zůstat bez členu. Proto se tyto vazby učí jako celek, ne skládají: není co odvozovat, jen co poznat.

table.caption: adding an article breaks the phrase
rows: I go to work by car.
I go to work by the car.
She is in charge of the project.
She is in the charge of the project.
He explained it in a detail.
They work side by the side.

points: by + transport takes no article: by car, by train, by bus — but on foot.
Role and manner phrases stay bare: in charge of, on behalf of, in person, by hand.
Repeated-noun pairs stay bare on both sides: face to face, step by step.

cards.title: The quality or one instance of it
cards.body: An abstract noun is uncountable while it names the quality itself and countable the moment it names one instance of that quality. Business is what a company does; a business is one company. Experience is what you accumulate; an experience is one event. Success is the general outcome; a success is one thing that worked. The same split runs through time, difficulty, doubt and surprise, and the article is the only thing marking it — the noun itself does not change. Czech usually has two different words here, or a different construction altogether, so the difficulty is not the rule but noticing that a choice is being asked for at all. The rule is short: no article for the quality, a or an for one countable instance of it, and a plural exists only on the instance reading — difficulties and doubts are fine, business meaning commerce has no plural.
cards.body_cz: Abstraktní podstatné jméno je nepočitatelné, dokud pojmenovává samotnou vlastnost, a počitatelné ve chvíli, kdy pojmenuje jeden její konkrétní případ. Business je to, co firma dělá; a business je jedna firma. Experience jsou nasbírané zkušenosti; an experience je jeden zážitek. Success je celkový výsledek; a success je jedna věc, která vyšla. Stejně se dělí time, difficulty, doubt i surprise a jediné, co ten rozdíl značí, je člen — samotné podstatné jméno se nemění. Čeština tu obvykle má dvě různá slova nebo rovnou jinou vazbu, takže obtížné není to pravidlo, nýbrž vůbec si všimnout, že se tu na něco vybírá. Pravidlo je krátké: bez členu pro vlastnost, a nebo an pro jeden počitatelný případ, a množné číslo existuje jen u toho konkrétního čtení — difficulties a doubts jsou v pořádku, business ve významu obchodování množné číslo nemá.

table.caption: same noun, two readings
rows: Business is slower in the summer.

points: No article for the quality; a or an for one instance of it.
Only the instance reading has a plural: difficulties, doubts, successes.
The noun does not change — the article carries the whole difference.

cards.title: the because the structure fixes it
cards.title_cz: the proto, že je určeno strukturou
cards.body: Some nouns take the not because the reader has met them before but because the structure has already pinned them down. A noun followed by a that-clause or a full relative is fixed by that clause and takes the: the fact that no one answered, the reason why they left, the way in which it was done, the extent to which it matters. The same holds in the quantity frames the number of, the amount of, the cost of, the risk of — and the number of is not a number of, which means several and takes a plural verb. What these frames have in common is that the noun is never on its own: something after it has already narrowed it to one thing, so the is not a choice the writer makes but a consequence of the structure. Czech marks none of it, and because the noun itself looks abstract and general — fact, extent, way, risk, cost, value — the pull is to leave it bare, which is exactly where the mistake happens.
cards.body_cz: Některá podstatná jména mají the ne proto, že by je čtenář už znal, ale proto, že je struktura sama předem určila. Podstatné jméno následované vedlejší větou s that nebo plnou vztažnou větou je touto větou ukotveno a bere the: the fact that no one answered, the reason why they left, the way in which it was done, the extent to which it matters. Totéž platí ve vazbách množství the number of, the amount of, the cost of, the risk of — a the number of není a number of, které znamená několik a pojí se s množným číslem slovesa. Společné mají tyto vazby to, že podstatné jméno nikdy nestojí samo: něco za ním je už předem zúžilo na jednu jedinou věc, takže the není volba pisatele, nýbrž důsledek struktury. Čeština nic z toho neznačí, a protože podstatné jméno samo působí abstraktně a obecně — fact, extent, way, risk, cost, value — svádí to nechat je bez členu, a přesně tam vzniká chyba.

table.caption: the is not optional here
rows: the fact that no one answered
The number of students has increased.
A number of students has increased.
the extent to which it matters

points: A noun pinned down by a that-clause or a relative takes the.
the number of takes a singular verb; a number of means several and takes a plural one.
In all of these the noun is narrowed by what follows it — the is a consequence, not a choice.

items.gap: ____ of the meeting was never explained.
accepts: The point of the meeting was never explained.
items.explanation: Some nouns take the not because the reader has met them before but because the structure has already pinned them down. A noun followed by a that-clause or a full relative is fixed by that clause and takes the: the fact that no one answered, the reason why they left, the way in which it was done, the extent to which it matters. The same holds in the quantity frames the number of, the amount of, the cost of, the risk of — and the number of is not a number of, which means several and takes a plural verb. What these frames have in common is that the noun is never on its own: something after it has already narrowed it to one thing, so the is not a choice the writer makes but a consequence of the structure. Czech marks none of it, and because the noun itself looks abstract and general — fact, extent, way, risk, cost, value — the pull is to leave it bare, which is exactly where the mistake happens.
items.explanation_cz: Některá podstatná jména mají the ne proto, že by je čtenář už znal, ale proto, že je struktura sama předem určila. Podstatné jméno následované vedlejší větou s that nebo plnou vztažnou větou je touto větou ukotveno a bere the: the fact that no one answered, the reason why they left, the way in which it was done, the extent to which it matters. Totéž platí ve vazbách množství the number of, the amount of, the cost of, the risk of — a the number of není a number of, které znamená několik a pojí se s množným číslem slovesa. Společné mají tyto vazby to, že podstatné jméno nikdy nestojí samo: něco za ním je už předem zúžilo na jednu jedinou věc, takže the není volba pisatele, nýbrž důsledek struktury. Čeština nic z toho neznačí, a protože podstatné jméno samo působí abstraktně a obecně — fact, extent, way, risk, cost, value — svádí to nechat je bez členu, a přesně tam vzniká chyba.
